    房贷利率是影响消费者借贷成本的重要因素之一。如果利率上升，购房者的负担能力可能会下降，反之亦然。

    丹麦议会选举的结果可能会影响该国与欧盟及其他国际伙伴的关系，并且在当前的地缘政治背景下具有重要意义。

本日聚焦三则重要新闻，涵盖篮球、棒球和职业橄榄球领域。

  • David Levy：NCAA锦标赛背后的推手

    David Levy是March Madness背后的关键人物。他为Turner Broadcasting服务33年，并在担任总裁期间扩展了该网络的NBA转播权。Levy通过与CBS和Turner网络达成10.8亿美元的权利协议，使得每场NCAA锦标赛都能在全国电视上播出。

    Levy的故事展示了体育媒体如何利用商业策略来扩大观众基础并增加收入来源。

  • Alex Rodriguez：MLB需要抓住世界棒球经典赛的势头

    2026年世界棒球经典赛吸引了大量观众，观看人数比上一届增加了142%。Alex Rodriguez在The Deal节目中讨论了这一现象，并强调了MLB总裁Rob Manfred应如何利用这种势头。

    Rodriguez的观点揭示了体育赛事如何通过媒体推广来提升其影响力和商业价值。

  • NFL球星Bobby Wagner：向Michael Jordan和Magic Johnson学习

    Bobby Wagner是NFC历史上唯一一位达到2000次擒抱的四分卫之一。他正在通过投资科技初创公司和成为WNBA球队的所有者来实现自己的商业目标。Wagner在The Deal节目中分享了他对NFL合同的理解以及如何从Larry Johnson和Magic Johnson的故事中汲取灵感。

    Wagner的故事展示了体育明星如何利用他们的影响力进行多元化投资，从而创造更多的商业机会。

  • David Levy is the Reason You’re Watching March Madness

    It&rsquo;s brackets season! And you can watch all 67 games of both the women&rsquo;s and men&rsquo;s NCAA tournament on national TV, thanks to David Levy. Levy spent 33 years at Turner Broadcasting, eventually serving as its president, where he expanded the network&rsquo;s NBA coverage. Levy is probably best known for brokering a $10.8 billion rights agreement that made every March Madness game available nationally across CBS and the Turner networks for the very first time. In this episode of The Deal, Alex and Jason talk to Levy about the ins and outs of the March Madness deal. He also tells the story of how he got Shaq to fill Inside the NBA&rsquo;s fourth chair and why the key to that show&rsquo;s success is letting Charles Barkley talk. Finally, Levy shares more about his current venture, Horizon Sports & Experiences, and why he&rsquo;s betting big on women&rsquo;s sports and pickleball. You can also watch this interview on the Bloomberg Podcasts YouTube page . See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.
